comment: Port matrix. Claude Code is not listed: it always ships the full feature set and is the source of truth. Each platform below is a projection: which reference docs inject at session start and which skills ship. utils/generate-platform-assets.sh projects this into codex/, pi/, and the root hooks.json. The communication guidelines inject on every platform — Claude Code and Codex through SessionStart hooks, Pi through the extension, which reads the same list. Two documents are listed nowhere here and are Claude-only by ruling: execution-guidelines.md, and clear-expression.md, which repeats on every prompt and would cost a small context window more than it buys. Two skills are Claude-only by ruling (2026-09-05) and are likewise listed nowhere here: review-doc drives the Workflow tool and fix-issues the AskUserQuestion tool, and neither tool exists off Claude Code. All four skills are user-invoked only, never model-triggered; the generator projects that per platform.
